writerSelfReportIsNotEvidence: each run's `handlers:` line is the shell reporting which handlers it attached. It is carried in runs[] and graded by nothing: a process reporting its own effect is the shape of claim DEF-079 is about. What is graded is the line each handler wrote.
notMeasured: a real stowed exception at 0xC000027B below the managed dispatch boundary - the route DEF-079 was found through. The injected UI fault is an ordinary managed exception in XAML dispatch; nothing on this host can raise the other (DEF-086)

a throw from a DispatcherQueue callback: run here as an UNGRADED probe because it reaches no handler at all, which is DEF-085 rather than a fault in the three handlers this lane grades. notes[] records what the probe saw on this run
that a handler fires in a RELEASE build - the injection is compiled out outside DEBUG, so this lane grades the Debug binary only
that the log survives a process kill mid-write - StartupLog appends synchronously per line, which is assumed rather than witnessed here
notes: ungraded probe, --fault dispatcher: a throw from a DispatcherQueue callback on the UI thread was caught by NO handler - the process vanished after `fault: injecting` with nothing appended. DEF-085 carries it.
